blocks.text: Malaysian Oscar-winning actress Michelle Yeoh is set to visit the Philippines for the promotional tour of the sci-fi limited series “Bladerunner 2099.” Yeoh’s visit comes ahead of the series’ global premiere on Nov. 25. During her visit, the actress will meet with Philippine and Asia-Pacific media for exclusive interviews and join a special screening of her new series, as confirmed by Prime Video in a press release on Friday, Nov. 20.
